name: TPP riboswitch bound to CCC (thiamine pyrophosphate analog, chain X)
affinitySource: Kulshina N et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2009, PMC2802028
notes: TPP (thiamine pyrophosphate) riboswitch aptamer from Arabidopsis thaliana. CCC ligand is a thiamine pyrophosphate analog (pyrithiamine pyrophosphate). Two-domain fold: aminopyrimidine arm stacks on G39, pyrophosphate chelates Mg via backbone P. Chain X used (two symmetric copies in asymmetric unit). Key exercise for both baseStacking (pyrimidine arm) and phosphateElectrostatic (pyrophosphate tail).
affinityNotes: TPP binds thiM riboswitch Kd ~9 nM at 2.5 mM Mg2+ (Kulshina et al. 2009). CCC (pyrithiamine pyrophosphate analog) Kd not directly measured for 2GDI.

enrichmentSets.description: TPP riboswitch actives (thiamine analogs) vs filtered non-nucleotide decoys. 2GDI receptor includes 3 Mg²⁺ ions — canonical TPP benchmark case with metal coordination. Best enrichment at 1k screen (AUC 0.574 vs 0.320 for 2HOJ without Mg).
enrichmentSets.source: Literature actives (thiamine analogs) + ChEMBL property-matched decoys filtered to exclude P atoms and nucleobase scaffolds (no purines, pyrimidines, nucleosides, phosphates)
enrichmentSets.intendedUse: active-vs-decoy enrichment with nucleotide-chemotype decoys excluded
